integrity: Every simple game through five players is enumerated from its minimal-winning antichain, properness is checked directly, Banzhaf and Johnston are each computed in two exact formulations, and all divergent five-player games are canonicalized under every player relabeling.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for proper simple games through five players and compares weak player rankings rather than numerical distances. No claim is made for six or more players or for a complete classification of non-proper games.
title: Sharp five-player tie-refinement boundary for Johnston and Banzhaf power rankings
